payload.ticket_title: CERT-AUTOEXEC-GPT read-only two-poll control service check
payload.ticket_markdown:
## Objective
Use the registered service_two_poll_check handler to perform exactly two read-only polls of brittle-messages-control.service, exactly 10 seconds apart.

## Preconditions
1. The lane is control.
2. The registered handler is service_two_poll_check.
3. The target is brittle-messages-control.service.
## Steps
1. Claim the ticket autonomously.
2. Record ActiveState, MainPID, and NRestarts on poll 1.
3. Wait exactly 10 seconds.
4. Record the same fields on poll 2.
5. Publish a completion report.
## Acceptance criteria
1. Exactly two polls.
2. The interval is exactly 10 seconds.
3. ActiveState, MainPID, and NRestarts are unchanged.
4. No service or other state mutation occurs.
## Prohibitions
Do not start, stop, restart, reload, modify, or reconfigure any service, file, code, policy, or production BRITTLE state.
## Required report
The report must include the ticket ID, autonomous claim receipt, handler, target service, both timestamps, the measured interval, both values for ActiveState, MainPID, and NRestarts, per-criterion pass or fail, and an explicit statement that no state-changing action occurred.
